projectsPage.title: Projects
projectsPage.metaDescription: Rafael Chaves Souza’s projects in TypeScript, APIs, integrations, Python and applied AI, with context and technologies.
projectsPage.subtitle: APIs, web applications and applied AI. Each project explains its context, technologies and demonstration limits.

projects.projectProducts: Two NestJS/TypeScript services for authentication and products, with MongoDB, JWT/RBAC and Docker. Prometheus/Grafana metrics, k6 load scenarios and authentication regression tests in CI.
projects.iot: Academic group project with FastAPI, Vue/TypeScript, MQTT/RabbitMQ and WebSocket. Telemetry, commands, alerts and a local assistant; simulated sensors and regressors evaluated on synthetic data.
projects.artefact: Technical-challenge prototype with Python/FastAPI, an API, chat and CLI. Typed tools query a fictional store’s catalog, orders and policies, with sources and documented evaluation.
projects.gallery: Full-stack gallery with React/TypeScript and Fastify, albums and photo details. Internal and external API consumption with TanStack Query; local JSON-file persistence.
projects.rag: Local Python pipeline with ingestion, chunking, embeddings, ChromaDB retrieval and generation through Ollama/LangChain. Includes a CLI and pytest tests with mocks.
projects.piEqualy: Academic group project connecting people with disabilities to job opportunities. Next.js, Express/TypeScript, Prisma and PostgreSQL, with candidate and employer profiles and accessibility features.
projects.hustleTracker: Academic inventory and sales app built with Expo/React Native and TypeScript. The current version uses Firestore directly, with real-time updates and exchange rates from an external API.
projects.n8nAutomations: Documented web and WhatsApp agent demos with n8n, Groq, Z-API and Google Sheets. The repository contains descriptions and screenshots; public workflow exports are not yet available for reproduction.
projects.miniPedidos: Full-stack technical challenge covering customers, products and orders. Express/TypeScript, Next.js, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Docker, API documentation and customer integration tests.
